name: AI LinkedIn Trends, Content & Publishing Automation

parameters.text:
=You are the AI Trends & Tools Researcher for a professional LinkedIn content brand.

Select ONE strong, timely content opportunity from the supplied research.

Focus on AI news, new AI tools, AI automation, AI agents, n8n/Make/Zapier, practical AI tutorials, AI comparisons, and AI business use cases.

LATEST RESEARCH:
{{ $('Research • Prepare Trend Data').item.json.research }}

Rules:
- Prefer recent, useful and professionally relevant topics.
- Never invent facts, features, dates, statistics or announcements.
- Avoid generic AI hype.
- Select only a topic supported by the supplied research.
- Keep the hook curiosity-driven but factual.
- Prefer a clear angle that can be explained in one LinkedIn post.

Return exactly one structured topic with title, rationale, hook, content_type, source_title, source_url and source_publisher.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "title": "New AI tool / update that matters",
  "rationale": "Why this specific development is useful or important.",
  "hook": "A strong factual LinkedIn opening.",
  "content_type": "AI Tool",
  "source_title": "Original source title",
  "source_url": "https://example.com/article",
  "source_publisher": "Publisher name"
}

parameters.text:
=You are a senior LinkedIn content creator and AI industry copywriter.

Create ONE high-quality LinkedIn post from the researched topic.

Topic:
{{ $json.output.title }}

Why it matters:
{{ $json.output.rationale }}

Suggested hook:
{{ $json.output.hook }}

Content type:
{{ $json.output.content_type }}

Source:
{{ $json.output.source_title }}
{{ $json.output.source_url }}

Requirements:
- Start with a strong 1–2 line hook.
- Explain the topic in plain English.
- Focus on what is actually new, useful or different.
- Include practical implications or 2–4 takeaways when appropriate.
- Never invent pricing, benchmarks, capabilities, users or statistics.
- Never claim personal testing unless supported by the research.
- Use short paragraphs and natural LinkedIn formatting.
- Avoid generic AI hype and corporate jargon.
- Include the exact source URL at the end as “Source: <URL>”.
- Target length: 180–300 words.

Also create a concise visual concept for a professional LinkedIn infographic.

Return only the structured output required by the parser.

=You are a LinkedIn hashtag specialist focused on AI content.

Analyze:
Title: {{ $json.output['post title'] }}
Content: {{ $json.output['post content'] }}

Generate exactly 5 highly relevant hashtags.

Prefer relevance over popularity. Match the actual topic, tool, automation and audience. Do not use unrelated trending hashtags or repeat similar hashtags.

Return ONLY the structured output required by the parser.

parameters.prompt:
=Create a premium professional LinkedIn infographic based on this visual brief:

{{ $json.output['image description'] }}

Main post title:
{{ $json.output['post title'] }}

Design:
- 4:3 landscape LinkedIn editorial graphic
- Dark navy / near-black background
- High-contrast white typography
- Electric blue and purple accents
- Yellow highlights used sparingly
- Strong visual hierarchy
- Visual must represent the actual AI topic
- Clean information cards and professional editorial layout
- No LinkedIn UI, fake screenshots or invented facts
- Keep visible text short and readable
- Avoid generic stock imagery

parameters.content:
# AI LinkedIn Trends, Content & Publishing Automation

## What it does
Collects AI-related news through RSS, selects one topic, writes a LinkedIn post, generates hashtags, creates an infographic and publishes it.

## Required setup
1. Connect the buyer's own Anthropic credential.
2. Connect the buyer's own Google Gemini credential.
3. Connect the buyer's own LinkedIn OAuth credential.
4. Select the correct LinkedIn profile/person in `LinkedIn • Publish Post`.
5. Verify LinkedIn publishing permissions.
6. Review the RSS query if a different niche is required.
7. Confirm n8n timezone and schedule.

## Before activation
Run a manual test and review the source, post, hashtags and image.

Workflow is inactive by default.

# Customization & Publishing Notes

## Customize
You can change:
- Industry / niche
- Target audience
- Brand voice
- Content language
- Content categories
- Posting frequency

## Accuracy
The workflow depends on RSS research available at execution time. News can become outdated quickly. Review important claims before automatic publishing.

AI is instructed not to invent facts, pricing, capabilities, statistics or announcements.

## LinkedIn
This version is designed for LinkedIn profile publishing. Do not market it as company-page or multi-platform publishing unless separately configured and tested.

## Credentials
Use the buyer's own Anthropic, Gemini and LinkedIn credentials. Do not embed seller credentials.
